rec.name: PDP Store Benefits (Icon + Text USP Section with Normal / Tabbed-Slider Layouts)

what.text: A configurable Shopify section for the product page that shows up to 4 store benefits (e.g. free shipping from €35, 100-day returns, free spare-parts service, pay within 30 days via Klarna). Each benefit has an icon (SVG or uploaded image/logo) and optional text. It has two styles. 'Normal' shows a grid of icon + text items, which can be laid out vertically or horizontally with a configurable number per row on desktop and mobile. 'Slider' shows a row of icon tabs; clicking an icon switches the headline and longer text below it, and the selected icon can swap to an 'active' icon version.

why.text: Placed near the buy buttons, it answers last-minute purchase objections (shipping cost, returns, payment terms, warranty) at the point of decision. This lowers perceived risk and reinforces the value of buying from this store. Short icon + text pairs are scannable. The tabbed slider variant packs more reassurance into little space through progressive disclosure. Logo/image support also allows it to double as a trust-badge or payment-logo strip.

how.text: Create a store-benefits snippet (CSS + Liquid + small JS for tab switching) and render it from the product section/template with the benefit settings passed in. In the 'normal' style it renders a CSS grid with a configurable column count (desktop/mobile) and per-item flex layout (icon + text). In the 'slider' style it renders a header row of icons with a 4px underline on the active item, and a content area where only the active benefit's text is visible. A click handler toggles the 'active' class. Colors, font size, icon size, padding, gap and border radius are exposed as settings, and an SVG field overrides the image field. Later the benefits were refactored into theme BLOCKS (one block per benefit with its own settings and an 'Enable benefit' toggle) to keep the settings panel manageable. Editor note: icons are clickable in the editor to preview each tab.

items: Background of the block (color, can be transparent)
Number of benefits in a row (desktop)
Number of benefits in a row (mobile)
Enable bold text (applies to all benefits)
Per-benefit: SVG code (overrides image if set)
Per-benefit: active icon image / active SVG (slider style)
Per-benefit: text (headline) and optional second longer text (slider style)
Separate font size and icon size for desktop and mobile (per the code)
Up to 4 benefits; text optional so the section can serve as a logo strip

dependencies.text: Shopify theme with Liquid and the ability to add a snippet and a render call (non-devs cannot install it; ticket says 'Einbau durch Non-Devs: not possible'). Benefits are theme section/block settings, so no metafields or apps are needed. The original code uses the deprecated img_url filter and lazyload classes, and the slider JS uses global selectors, so multiple instances on one page may conflict. Slider colors (#FBF6EF, #000000) are hard-coded. The 1000px breakpoint is hard-coded.

items: Click rate on slider tabs (slider style)
Cart abandonment and support tickets about shipping/returns (secondary)

images.caption: Vertical 'Normal' layout: four benefits with line icons (free shipping from €35, 100-day returns, free spare-parts service, Klarna pay in 30 days).
Horizontal layout example below the buy button: payment logos row, Klarna line, and two pill-style benefits (365-day warranty, return until Christmas).

Theme editor with Slider style on the PDP: four icon tabs under the buy buttons with the active tab underlined and its text shown below; settings panel with background, text color, padding, radius, gaps and number per row.
Block-based version: Store benefits as a block under the Product page template with 'Enable benefit' toggle, icon image and SVG fields.
Block settings: First store benefit with Enable benefit toggle, Icon image, SVG (overrides image), and Icon image active / SVG active.
